steps.label: observe_complete_smoke_first_lifecycle
steps.objective: From the verified unlit initially unaware closed-window copy, light the indoor brazier with ordinary lighter use and maintain the real smoke signal through same-ID cannibal notice, scout dispatch, three-OMT watch, physical return/report, and the actual night assault. Track actor actions, targets, positions, health and deaths; an attributed raid kill is a valid outcome.
proof_targets: exact disposable profile/save, immutable executable/source, runtime binding and saved-turn identity
ordinary player visibility; no clairvoyance, cloak, invulnerability or raider-killing setup
closed windows, initially unlit brazier, no prior cannibal site/actor/contact, Safe Off
ordinary lighter action and verified fd_fire then fd_smoke at the prepared indoor brazier
smoke-attributed natural camp admission and same-ID scouting dispatch
same-ID three-OMT watch, physical return and report while fire remains lit
actual committed cannibal night pursuit/attack, attacker, target, damage and outcome; attributed raid kill may pass
fresh native quicksaves, saved turns, NPC roster/health/action metadata, simulation turn timing and graceful cleanup
invariants: No signal, fire, smoke, light, contact, report, dispatch or hostile movement injection
No clairvoyance, cloak, invulnerability or debug killing of raiders
Preserve the indoor brazier fire through the assault arm; do not extinguish it at roster formation
Use ordinary lighter and currently advertised Look Cursor/item controls
Keep source attribution for smoke distinct from any other signal
Choose native wait mode for evidence: harmless chatter may be ignored; combat-through-death is deliberate and death can be valid only with actor attribution
Follow relevant native actor IDs and friendly roster from metadata, not screen visibility alone
Verify Safe Off after World and after reload; save meaningful turns and verify disk turn

evidence_contract.claim: From an initially unaware disposable closed-room camp setup in recorded clear weather, walk to and light the prepared brazier with the supplied lighter; prove valid smoke before any valid light/contact seeds the camp, then observe natural notice, dispatch, three-OMT stalking, real homeward return and the applicable later faction attack.
evidence_contract.failure_rule: Credit only observed native ordered transitions under valid initial conditions. Preserve first divergence and exact continuation; setup and short noticing alone cannot settle ecology.
